program_name: Enbridge Home Efficiency Rebate — High-Efficiency Boiler
description: Fixed rebate for replacing an existing natural gas boiler with a condensing natural gas boiler with minimum 90% AFUE. Applies to residential and small multi-residential retrofits in the Enbridge Gas service territory. Claim is submitted after installation with proof of purchase and equipment rating plate details.
eligible_equipment: Condensing natural gas boiler, minimum 90% AFUE, ENERGY STAR certified models qualify automatically

program_name: Home Renovation Savings Program — High-Efficiency Heating
description: Ontario-wide rebate program co-delivered by Enbridge Gas and the IESO. Provides fixed incentives for high-efficiency space heating upgrades in existing homes, including a $1,200 incentive for qualifying high-efficiency condensing heating systems and additional amounts for smart thermostats and building envelope measures.
eligible_equipment: High-efficiency condensing space heating system meeting program efficiency thresholds; smart thermostats; insulation and air sealing measures

description: Federal interest-free financing of up to $40,000 repaid over 10 years for eligible home energy retrofits, including heat pumps, high-efficiency heating, insulation, windows, and solar. Requires a pre-retrofit EnerGuide evaluation before work begins and a post-retrofit evaluation after completion. No rebate amount — the value is the financing terms.
eligible_equipment: Cold-climate air-source heat pumps, high-efficiency space and water heating, building envelope upgrades, rooftop solar photovoltaic systems

program_name: Enbridge Commercial Boiler Retrofit Incentive (Territory Representative)
description: Commercial boiler-retrofit incentive administered through named Enbridge territory representatives. The contractor emails a completed equipment form with the existing boiler's make, model, serial number, and efficiency plus the proposed replacement's make, model, and rated efficiency. The representative returns the projected annual gas savings and total incentive amount, typically within 2 to 5 business days. No pre-installation gate; figures are confirmed before proposal.
eligible_equipment: Commercial condensing boilers and near-condensing hydronic heating plant replacements in multi-residential, institutional, and commercial buildings

description: Custom-calculated incentive for commercial gas-efficiency projects, paid per cubic metre of natural gas saved annually, capped at 75% of incremental project cost up to $100,000 per project ($500,000 for institutional). Intake runs through a web form; an Energy Solutions Advisor is assigned and pre-project approval is mandatory before installation begins. Incentive figures remain estimates until approved.
eligible_equipment: Custom commercial gas-efficiency measures: boiler plant replacements, heat-recovery ventilation, make-up air units, process heating upgrades, building automation

program_name: Save on Energy Retrofit Program — Prescriptive Stream
description: IESO electricity-efficiency program offering fixed published incentive amounts per installed measure for Ontario businesses. Application is submitted through the participant portal and project approval is required before equipment is purchased or installed. Program rules and incentive tables change effective June 30, 2026 — verify current values before relying on them.
eligible_equipment: High-efficiency HVAC measures including ECM circulator pumps, demand control ventilation, variable frequency drives, LED lighting retrofits

program_name: Save on Energy Retrofit Program — Custom Stream
description: Custom-calculated electricity-efficiency incentive paid per kilowatt-hour of verified first-year savings, up to 50% of eligible project cost. An engineering review establishes the savings estimate, and mandatory pre-project approval applies before installation. Submitted and tracked through the participant portal.
eligible_equipment: Custom electricity-saving measures: chiller plant upgrades, compressed air systems, ventilation heat recovery, motor and drive retrofits

program_name: City of Toronto Energy Retrofit Loan
description: Municipal low-interest financing for energy retrofits in Toronto buildings, repaid through installments on the property tax bill. Covers building envelope, mechanical system, and renewable energy upgrades in residential and multi-residential properties. No rebate amount — proposal value is modelled as interest savings versus a market-rate loan. Applications are reviewed by city program staff.
eligible_equipment: Building envelope improvements, high-efficiency heating and cooling plant replacements, domestic hot water systems, renewable energy installations

program_name: Home Electrification and Appliance Rebate (HEEHRA) — Heat Pump, California
description: Income-qualified point-of-sale rebate of up to $8,000 for ENERGY STAR certified electric heat pumps providing space heating and cooling, administered state by state under the federal Inflation Reduction Act. California single-family reservations were fully subscribed as of February 24, 2026 — roughly three months after funding opened. Contractors not already enrolled and trained missed the window entirely.
eligible_equipment: ENERGY STAR certified electric heat pump for space heating and cooling, ducted or ductless, installed by an enrolled contractor

description: Federal whole-home rebate of $2,000 to $8,000 based on household income and modelled or measured whole-home energy savings, administered by state energy offices. The rebate amount is produced by an approved energy model or measured utility data rather than a published table, and the application requires state program approval before work qualifies.
eligible_equipment: Whole-home retrofit packages: heating and cooling equipment, insulation, air sealing, duct sealing, mechanical ventilation

description: Federal income tax credit equal to 30% of project cost for qualified high-efficiency equipment: up to $600 for natural gas hot water boilers and furnaces meeting the CEE highest efficiency tier, and up to $2,000 for qualified electric heat pumps. Claimed on the homeowner's tax return — no application, no program submission.
eligible_equipment: Qualified natural gas hot water boilers and furnaces at CEE highest efficiency tier; electric and natural gas heat pumps; heat pump water heaters

description: Zero-percent financing of up to $25,000 over seven years for qualified energy-efficiency improvements in Massachusetts homes, offered through sponsor utilities and participating lenders. Requires a no-cost home energy assessment before loan authorization. No rebate amount — the value is the interest-free term.
eligible_equipment: High-efficiency heating systems, heat pumps, water heaters, insulation, windows approved through the home energy assessment

program_name: National Grid Commercial Custom Gas Efficiency (NY)
description: Custom commercial gas-efficiency incentive for thermal load reduction projects in upstate New York, including steam system upgrades and hydronic heating plant replacements. A program engineer reviews submitted equipment specifications and returns the approved incentive, calculated per therm of first-year savings. Pre-approval is required before equipment purchase.
eligible_equipment: Steam and hydronic heating plant upgrades, condensing boilers, boiler controls, steam trap surveys, heat recovery

program_name: FortisBC Commercial Space Heating — Condensing Boiler Rebate
description: Fixed rebate per qualifying sealed-combustion condensing appliance installed in commercial hydronic heating plants in the FortisBC natural gas service area. Equipment must achieve a minimum 94% thermal efficiency. Application is submitted online after installation with invoices and AHRI certificates.
eligible_equipment: Sealed-combustion condensing hydronic heating appliances, minimum 94% thermal efficiency, commercial capacity

description: Fixed incentives for high-efficiency natural gas heating equipment in Saskatchewan commercial buildings, including condensing furnaces, unit heaters, and infrared tube heaters. Rebate amounts are published per equipment category and claimed through a dealer-submitted application after installation.
eligible_equipment: High-efficiency natural gas furnaces, condensing unit heaters, low-intensity infrared tube heaters

description: Financial assistance for installing cold-climate air-source heat pumps in Québec residences, covering centrally ducted systems and ductless mini-split units sized to the dwelling's heating load. Amounts vary by capacity and are claimed online with the installer's invoice.
eligible_equipment: Cold-climate air-source heat pumps (thermopompes), centrally ducted or ductless mini-split, meeting NEEP cold-climate specifications

program_name: Oil to Heat Pump Affordability Program
description: Federal grant of up to $10,000 for income-eligible households that heat with home heating oil to convert to a cold-climate electric heat pump. Requires confirmation of oil heating, household income eligibility, and program approval before installation. Delivered with provincial co-delivery partners in several provinces.
eligible_equipment: Cold-climate electric air-source heat pumps replacing oil-fired furnaces and boilers, installed by qualified contractors

description: Incentive for installing Level 2 networked electric vehicle charging stations at Ontario workplaces and commercial parking facilities. Covers a fixed amount per connector port, claimed after installation with electrical inspection certificates.
eligible_equipment: Level 2 networked electric vehicle supply equipment (EVSE), dual-port pedestal or wall-mount charging stations

description: Instant point-of-sale discount on qualifying smart thermostats purchased through participating retailers in the Enbridge service territory. No application — the discount is applied at checkout.
eligible_equipment: ENERGY STAR certified smart learning thermostats from participating manufacturers
